name: Be a Battery
desc:
🔋Be a Battery

You are a battery with one goal... Server domination.

💪Grow your charge and become the strongest on the server! The stronger you get, the higher you get on the GLOBAL leader board! 

**⚠️This is the real and true legacy version of the main game "Be a Battery : Steal Power", Any other experience besides "Be a Battery : LEGACY" AND "Be a Battery : Steal Power" is a copy made by a third party or the developers fired from the main project. **


**Provide any feedback or bug report through group forum so we can improve the game!**
